capacity_metric_note: Q_sim integrates the experimentally measured current over the experimental time window, so Q_sim ~= Q_exp by construction.  Do NOT read baseline Q_sim-Q_exp as a capacity prediction; predictive capacity requires a constant-current run where the model itself reaches the cutoff.

parameter_match.notes: Unfitted surrogate baseline - NOT physics-model validation. PyBaMM describes Ramadass2004 as a mixed ("Frankenstein") parameter set; it is chemistry-compatible (graphite/LiCoO2) but was fitted to a different cell.  Ecker2015 is a C-grade (mismatched) comparator: its Kokam SLPB75106100 cathode is Li(Ni0.4Co0.6)O2, not LiCoO2.
